in_sanskrit.name: Sachana
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Dawn, Goddess of Prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sachana एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sachana is a Hindu name that means 'Dawn' or 'Goddess of Prosperity'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sach-' meaning 'truth' and '-ana' meaning 'dawn'. This name is associated with the goddess of the same name, who is believed to bring prosperity and good fortune.
